name: list_dir
description: List the entries of a directory in the sandbox, one per line, with type and size.

params.name: path
params.description: Directory to list. Defaults to the mounted folder.

name: read_file
description: Read a file from the sandbox. Use this when you know the exact path; prefer search_files to find one.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file to read.

name: search_files
description: Search the mounted folder for a text pattern, returning matching lines with their file and line number.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Text or basic regular expression to search for.

params.name: path
params.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the mounted folder.
